lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: java-wicket-path-traversal-upload-filename
title: Upload storage path built from client file name or field id without canonical containment check
summary: 'The upload file manager builds a filesystem path by joining a base folder with the client-supplied
  file name or upload field id. It does not canonicalize the result or verify that it stays inside the
  base folder. A crafted name such as `../../x` lets an attacker write or read files outside the upload
  folder (path traversal).

  '
cwe:
- CWE-22
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- java
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 72470983f689c61e6a6c0b7388ef955f23bb1e16
  vulnerable_ref: 72470983f689c61e6a6c0b7388ef955f23bb1e16^
  patched_ref: 72470983f689c61e6a6c0b7388ef955f23bb1e16
  repository: https://github.com/apache/wicket
rule:
  message: 'A file path is built from a client-controlled file name or upload field id (`$NAME`) and used
    without canonicalizing it and checking that it stays inside the base folder. This allows path traversal.
    Resolve with getCanonicalFile()/toRealPath() and verify startsWith(baseFolder) before use.

    '
  mode: taint
  pattern-sources:
  - pattern: $UPLOAD.getClientFileName()
  - pattern: '(String $NAME)

      '
    focus-metavariable: $NAME
  pattern-sinks:
  - pattern: new File($DIR, $NAME)
    focus-metavariable: $NAME
  - pattern: new java.io.File($DIR, $NAME)
    focus-metavariable: $NAME
  - pattern: new FileOutputStream(new File($DIR, $NAME))
    focus-metavariable: $NAME
  pattern-sanitizers:
  - pattern: $X.getCanonicalFile()
  - pattern: $X.getCanonicalPath()
  - pattern: $X.toRealPath()
  - pattern: org.apache.commons.io.FilenameUtils.getName(...)
  - pattern: $X.getName()
fix:
  guidance: 'Never join a client-supplied file name or field id onto a base folder directly. Resolve the
    target to its canonical or real path and check that it starts with the canonical base folder path,
    throwing a SecurityException otherwise. Do this check in a single helper used by both save and getFile.
    Also close the streams with try-with-resources.

    '
  example: "Path base = getFolder().toPath().toRealPath();\njava.io.File dir = new File(getFolder(), uploadFieldId).getCanonicalFile();\n\
    if (!dir.toPath().startsWith(base)) {\n    throw new SecurityException(\"Path traversal detected in\
    \ uploadFieldId\");\n}\njava.io.File target = new File(dir, clientFileName).getCanonicalFile();\n\
    if (!target.toPath().startsWith(dir.toPath())) {\n    throw new SecurityException(\"Path traversal\
    \ detected in client filename\");\n}\n"
